items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I mention that because of Flip Phillips. This is how I first met Flip. We were working with Frankie Newton

ctx.x: I imagine so, but naturally he wasn't a member, so he couldn't tell who was a card carrier or whatever. I tell you. Speaking of communists I will digress a little bit, but I worked at one time with Frankie Newton. Have you ever heard of Frankie Newton. Frankie Newton was a very fine trumpet player. Frankie Newton and also in this band was a clarinet player by the name of Flip Phillips.
